Write the proposal being reviewed: read docs/history/agent-coordination-state-root/rfc-state-root-fix.md in full and restate its root-cause claim, evidence, and proposed fix shape as the formal proposal for this round.

Independently review the proposal in docs/history/agent-coordination-state-root/rfc-state-root-fix.md (read it in full). You do NOT get to see any other objector's own review.
